title: ZCode – Harness for GLM-5.2
summary: ZCode is a development harness and framework designed to help developers build applications with GLM-5.2, a large language model from Zhipu AI. It provides tools and infrastructure for optimizing, deploying, and effectively utilizing the model in production environments.
problem_solved: Provides a structured framework for developers to harness and deploy large language models like GLM-5.2 efficiently in real-world applications.
why_valuable: Reduces the complexity of working with large language models by providing pre-built tools and best practices, enabling faster development cycles and better model utilization.
